text:
viv: tiny WFH emergency: modem had to be relocated to my bedroom because the living room outlet died. i'm now running a 10m cable along the skirting board. photo: https://imgur.com/a/bedmodem (1 pic)
viv: taped the cable under the rug at the hallway with gaffer. safety first(ish). :grimacing:
omar: please tell me you unplugged the toaster first. rugs + cables are a bold look. :sweat_smile:
kelly: also, label both ends of the cable. future you will be grateful. plus the label makes it feel official.
viv: labeled. also put a little rug-clip so it doesn't creep. router sits on top of a shoebox turned upside-down for airflow. luxury.
tony: question did you check for packet loss? small cable misplacements can cause flakiness.
viv: ran a quick mtr to 8.8.8.8 while on a call:
```
host: 8.8.8.8
Loss%  Snt  Last   Avg  Best  Wrst StDev
  0.0%   10   12.3  12.9  12.1  14.5   0.7
```
viv: looks stable. no packet loss. call quality was fine.
kelly: love shoebox ventilation hack. add a cardboard chimney if it gets warm.
ops-bot: Reminder: if a network device is moved to a bedroom/shared space, ensure your work VM is on the company VPN and avoid sensitive screens in shared sightlines. See /security-guides.
omar: poll time: best temporary modem/router platform? 1) Shoe box 2) Bookshelf 3) Towel fort 4) On the fridge
kelly: 2 for me, bookshelf is discreet.
viv: 1 for now. shoebox is classy. :package:
tony: 4 is cursed but memorable.
ops-bot: Filed ticket if you need a temporary power strip: /hardware-request.
viv: ordering a small power-strip with spare outlets. if anyone wants a tutorial on taping ethernet under rugs, do ":thumbsup:" and i'll post a step-by-step and final pic.
kelly: +1 would love the gaffer technique.
omar: passing by to say this is peak remote-ingenuity. good work, viv.
viv: thanks! will post aftermath photo after cordification.
